title: Correctors subscribe to translation notifications and fix pages from the link
description:
As a person responsible for catching translation flaws in a language, I want to subscribe to that language's translation notifications and correct a page from the link in as few steps as possible, so translations improve without blocking publication.

Design (Ryan's decision 2): notification kind translation.published (class admin; facts title, language, page URL, correction link), subscriptions per site and language (needs Caducus scoped subscriptions, PPY task filed). Corrector role: managed role translator with a list of languages, granted through manage-user-role; the Cognito group opens only the correction view; the correction mutation checks the language list; editors and admins correct every language. Flow: link to /newsroom/translations/{localization}?block=N, Google sign-in returns to the link, source and translation side by side with check findings, edit a block and save, or Looks right. A correction is a new localization version by that person, changed blocks pinned, rule checks re-run on them, published at once; Looks right records a review and updates the label. Plan: docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (PR #1450), revised 2026-11-12 with Ryan's decisions.

Feature: Correcting translations

Scenario: A Spanish corrector gets a link and fixes a paragraph
  Given a person with the translator role for Spanish subscribed to Spanish translation notifications
  When a Spanish localization is published
  Then they receive a notification with a link to correct it
  And after signing in from the link they reword a paragraph and save
  And a new Spanish version by them is published with that paragraph pinned

Scenario: A corrector for one language cannot change another
  Given a person with the translator role for Spanish only
  When they try to save a change to a Chinese localization
  Then the change is refused with a message naming the languages they may correct

Scenario: Reviewing without edits
  Given a Spanish corrector reads a localization and finds nothing to change
  When they press Looks right
  Then the review is recorded on that version and the page label says it was reviewed by a person
